title: Build reuse rulings
description: The shared-capability-reviewer's ruling on each definition the build's reuse audit (build:reuse-audit) handed it: one ruling per handed definition id. build:reuse-ruled merges the rulings with the findings the deterministic reuse check settled into the reuseReview, and fails when a handed definition has no ruling.

definition.description: The id of the handed definition, as the definitions file names it (D1, D2, ...).

capability.description: For a duplicate: the candidate it duplicates, as the definitions file names it (<feature id>#<provides id>).

reason.description: One sentence: why the definition does or does not do what the capability exists to do.
